newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still a strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still a strong buy.

text.p: Morgan Stanley said it has maintained its strong buy rating on Brazilian federal telecom Telebras and set a new 12-month target price of $180 per American Depositary Receipt (ADR).
-- Morgan Stanley analyst Luiz Carvalho said in a report the new target price implies a "26-percent appreciation potential" from Tuesday's closing price.

-- "We expect that Telebras shares will continue to rise in coming months, boosted by multiples expansion as the market increasingly incorporates the regulatory progress being made toward full privatization," Carvalho wrote.
-- The federal Telebras system is slated to be broken into five regional operating units and sold off to private investors starting in 1998's first quarter.
-- The new target price, up from $145, was supported by discounted cash-flow analysis, regional multiples comparisons and Morgan Stanley's global telecommunications regression model, he said.
-- At $180 per ADR, Telebras would still trade at a small discount to other regional telecoms "on an estimated firm-value-to-EBITDA basis," he added.

-- "In our view, Telebras continues to be one of the most attractive telecom stocks in Latin America, offering attractive valuation levels, strong earnings growth potential and positive regulatory momentum," he wrote.
-- Telebras' ADR was up 1-1/8 at 144 in New York and its preferred share was up 0.54 percent at 155 reais and its common was down 0.28 at 140 reais in Sao Paulo at 1124 local/1424 gmt.
